entities.name: Louis Wade Sullivan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Wade Sullivan is an American physician, author and educator who served as the Secretary of the United States Department of Health and Human Services during President George H. W. Bush's Administration and was Founding Dean of the Morehouse School of Medicine.
